scope: Read-only replay of candidate order using D-only saved quality; R scores accessed only after selecting
policy: First candidate in declared execution order with complete input-supported metrics and every observed/path value <=0.8 times its existing threshold; if none, retain original complete-pool choice
margin_source: Existing registered trajectory target_margin_fraction; diagnostic engineering reserve, not a new acceptance threshold
fixed_rules: No format/window special cases; no R, candidate independent acceptance or source-jump masks in selection; all metrics count including timing and inserted path
qualification: Retrospective scheduling hypothesis; no default/pending656 change; unreviewed candidates remain unknown
next_gate: Any independently failed early choice blocks promotion; otherwise requires executable policy tests, fixed transfer and fresh complete656 under one version
